integrity_notes: All stated finite verification domains have been reproduced from the embedded Python program; the unbounded theorem follows from the self-contained rotation-order and last-column proof, not from enumeration. This is an original scientific claim requiring future independent review.
scientific_limitations: For circular, sentinel-free Burrows-Wheeler transform only; letter exponents are constant per symbol and must all be at least two. No assertions for suffix-BWT, occurrence-specific dilations, or invariance of run lengths. Source precedence for other equivalent formulations remains a residual risk.
title: BWT run-head saturation under independent letter dilations
